title: Advertising Strategy in the Presence of Reviews: An Empirical Analysis
authors: Brett Hollenbeck; Sridhar Moorthy; Davide Proserpio
eligible_reason: Regression discontinuity at TripAdvisor rating rounding thresholds (T = above threshold, local linear in centered cum_avg_ratings with year-month and brand FE) on hotel ad spending; McCrary test, placebo thresholds, bandwidths. No staggered binary adoption, no DiD.
design_notes: replication/synthetic-results.do: Tables 2-19 all use reg y c.T##c.cum_avg_ratings i.time i.brand within a 0.05 bandwidth of thresholds 3.25/3.75/4.25/4.75 (robust SE). Regression inventory (85 lines) is all RDD.
data_files_note: README.rtf: 'For privacy reasons, we provided a synthetic and anonymized version of the datasets containing Kantar and STR data'; results replicate 'closely (but not exactly)'.
data_provenance_note: Synthetic Kantar/STR hotel ad-spending data (search-ads file for an appendix table not labelled synthetic).
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text and papers/ checked Nov 2); OpenAlex abstract from data/frame/mksc.jsonl is empty. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
